notes.title: Major Game Update to game version 1.4.1
notes.content:
[h1][b]PATCH NOTES GAME VERSION 1.4.1.2[/b] [/h1][p][/p][h2]Major changes[/h2][p][b] [/b]1. Support for [b]16 LANGUAGES[/b] (English, Italian, French, Spanish, Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, German, Greek, Polish, Turkish, Russian, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese) [/p][p]2. New, improved tutorial scene that teaches you more about the game. [/p][p]3. New guide/help UI to help you learn more about the game. [/p][p]4. The crosshair now shows when you successfully hit enemies on their body (yellow) or head (red). [/p][p]5. Headshot damage logic implemented for double damage on enemies [/p][p]6. New Directional Damage HUD to know where you are being hit [/p][p]7. New labyrinths: They are now smaller and faster to traverse and solve, making for a more fun and faster gaming experience [/p][p][/p][h2]Minor changes[/h2][p][b]
[/b]1. Projectiles now make a sound based on the surface they hit. 
2. New labyrinths now have a unique combination of wall designs to help you better navigate the labyrinths. 
3. The audio trap has been improved with a new muffling sound effect and warning sound. 
4. Improved Blade Trap: Can now be shot at easily. 
5. New decorations in the labyrinths: pipes 
6. Many UI adaptations to accommodate all new languages. 
7. Tooltips added to game mode tiles. 
8. Added hints to the Death/Lose screen. 
9. Added in-game action suggestions. 
10. The weapon now has double the accuracy when you stand still. 
11. Improved explosion and trap effects. 
[/p][p][/p][h2][b][i]See you in the October NextFest here on Steam[/i][/b][/h2][h2][b]
Keep on Wishlisting![/b] [/h2][h2]
[b]Onto the next update![/b][/h2]

tags.feature: 1. Support for [b]16 LANGUAGES[/b] (English, Italian, French, Spanish, Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, German, Greek, Polish, Turkish, Russian, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese)

3. New guide/help UI to help you learn more about the game.

notes.title: Open Beta Live Now: Join Playtest
notes.content:
[h1]Change list game version 1.3.0.0[/h1][h2]Start of public playtest - Join the Beta test[/h2][p][/p][h3] Major Updates[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Languages:[/b] Complete support for 3 new languages: Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish (Latino America)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Demo/Story difficulty:[/b] new buttons on game settings to change game difficulty from Explorer (Very Easy) to Hardcore (very hard)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weapon bodies and components:[/b] now the 3 weapon bodies (Fire, Alien and Tesla) are separated from its trigger part which can be found in the labyrinths just like all the other components[/p][/*][*][p][b]Favorite projectile[/b]: now you can select in the Weapon Inventory UI the projectile you want to start with in the labyrinths [/p][/*][*][p][b]Game rebalance[/b]: Weapon stats rebalance to improve upgrading experience  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Minor Updates [/h3][list][*][p]New UI flow on first boot now opens Settings first [/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced game economy[/p][/*][*][p]Improved style of Settings UI, of both Inventories UI and of PlayLevel UI[/p][/*][*][p]New behavior or Audio Trap[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced freezing projectile[/p][/*][*][p]Better behavior of weapon components swap in the labyrinths[/p][/*][*][p]Better rarity colors of weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Better smoke trap effects[/p][/*][*][p]Fix enemy ghost attack[/p][/*][*][p]New weapon popup stats UI[/p][/*][*][p]Fix weapon shooting position from moving when rotating camera view[/p][/*][*][p]Fix components from being wrongly spawned in the labyrinths at random places[/p][/*][*][p]Fix infinite stamina cheat[/p][/*][*][p]New Weapon Inventory behavior: many fixes and better user experience[/p][/*][*][p]Fix effects HUD now always showing active positive and negative effects in the game[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][h3]Feedbacks[/h3]Remember to share your thoughts through the main menu feedback link on the top-right corner. This will help us a lot on improving the game before its official release on October

[h3]The Beta will remain Open until August 31, so go play now![/h3]

tags.feature: [b]New Languages:[/b] Complete support for 3 new languages: Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish (Latino America)
[b]Demo/Story difficulty:[/b] new buttons on game settings to change game difficulty from Explorer (Very Easy) to Hardcore (very hard)
[b]New Weapon bodies and components:[/b] now the 3 weapon bodies (Fire, Alien and Tesla) are separated from its trigger part which can be found in the labyrinths just like all the other components
[b]Favorite projectile[/b]: now you can select in the Weapon Inventory UI the projectile you want to start with in the labyrinths
